mentions.name: Your Next Store (YNS)
mentions.description: A Shopify alternative built with React and Next.js. It provides an opinionated boilerplate tailored for AI coding tools like Claude or Codex so designers and developers can build storefronts faster and more easily, enforcing a clear starting structure while keeping full control over design, animations, and the storefront experience. It is built on top of Stripe with higher-level commerce abstractions such as add to cart, checkout, pay, and browse products, plus a Commerce CMS so merchants can manage everything once their store is live.
mentions.problem: Building online storefronts can be slow and difficult; designers and developers need an opinionated, structured starting point to build stores faster and more easily.
mentions.audience: If you're planning to sell something online and want a modern solution
